name: The Great Ezra Grimm
summary: Smokey LaRue asks you to search Ezra Grimm’s smoke shop in Stratholme. He hopes a box of Grimm’s Premium Tobacco survived the town’s sack.

sections.title: Smokey’s Request
sections.body: Smokey LaRue remembers Ezra Grimm refusing to abandon his goods when Stratholme was sacked. Ezra said he would burn every leaf rather than let the attackers take them. Smokey left the shop, and fears Ezra died in the flames. Now he asks you to search the smoke shop for a box of Grimm’s Premium Tobacco.

faq.q: Who is asking me to search the shop?
faq.answer: Smokey LaRue asks you to look for a box of Grimm’s Premium Tobacco in Ezra Grimm’s smoke shop.
Ezra Grimm owned a smoke shop in Stratholme and prized the goods he kept there.
Stratholme was sacked while Ezra was still unwilling to leave his goods behind.
Smokey asks you to find a box of Grimm’s Premium Tobacco in Ezra’s smoke shop.

faq.q: Why does Smokey want the tobacco?
faq.answer: Smokey loves a good stogie and hopes at least one box of Ezra’s famous tobacco survived.
